people.name: Doctor Psionic
people.bio: Dr. Arthur Cromwell was a brilliant scientist and psychiatrist who specialized in creating new medicines to treat mental disorders. As part of his research, he accidentally discovered a compound that caused very unexpected results in animal test subjects. Convinced it would allow him to unlock the full potential of his brilliant mind, the doctor tested it on himself, with horrific results. It did indeed unlock parts of his brain, giving him mental powers, but it also corrupted his brain, transforming him from the good man he was before into an insane psychopath who is only interested in wealth and power.
people.story: Dr. Psionic hired Copperhead to steal the Infinity Codex from ORACLE and deliver it to the Genesis Alliance, then swooped in to take it for himself when the Ultras defeated the scientists in the Nevada desert. He trapped the team in his secret lair, then used the Codex to boost his powers and tried to mind control all of New York City. The Ultras rallied the city's citizens against him and defeated him in Times Square. He is now locked away in a special facility for super villains.

people.name: Copperhead
people.bio: A mutant with the ability to transform into a giant copperhead snake, David Lofkis works mostly as a mercenary for hire in various criminal plots. He has always felt like an outsider because of his mutation and is usually found working alone to complete a task assigned him by another criminal.
people.story: Hired by Dr. Psionic, Copperhead and a group of armed mercenaries stole the Infinity Codex from ORACLE headquarters. The Ultras tracked him to an abandoned air strip and, after a battle that nearly cost two of them their lives, defeated him. He revealed who had hired him and gave the team the coordinates of the Genesis Alliance's desert base. He is now locked away alongside Dr. Psionic.

people.name: Shockwave
people.bio: A former sound engineer who never found the career success he expected, Reed became bitter towards society and used his expertise to create a suit of armor that can generate sound at a very damaging level. He uses that suit to commit crimes and gather resources to make enhancements to the suit. He is extremely jealous of heroes that are adored by the public. He can use the sound waves as a ranged attack, focus them towards the ground to produce a form of flight, and the sound waves can be so disruptive as to cause those in his proximity to lose consciousness. His armor is sound dampening and protects him from the sound being emitted as well as providing some protection from attacks. Shockwave has made a habit of finding like-minded people to join him in his criminal endeavors, creating the super villain group Havoc.
people.story: Shockwave had the lawyer Erwin Lancaster recruit five villains and compile their profiles, forming Havoc. He attacked the Ultras Day parade, warned the city through the media, and later attacked the UN General Assembly alongside Kill Zone. As Maxwell Reed, he commissioned communication devices from Genesis Technologies and inquired about its gravity amplification devices, which were later stolen. In the final battle beneath the city he unleashed the full power of his suit in a sonic overload that threatened to bring the tunnel down on everyone. He was captured.

people.name: Blast Freeze
people.bio: Jason Franks was your typical teenager, a football player and decent student until his parents were killed in a tragic auto accident. His bitterness over their deaths led him to a life of petty crime. Soon thereafter, his mutant abilities showed themselves and he was able to generate ice, both as a weapon and as defense, able to encase himself in a layer of ice as armor. He uses his new found abilities to live a life of crime. Mentor to the villain known as Blaze.
people.story: Blast Freeze froze a large portion of the Hillview Reservoir to stop the water flowing into New York City, so that the stolen gravity devices could be loaded into the empty pipes. Thunder Bolt, Silver Star and the Tungsten Titan intervened. He escaped when the Ultras chose to save civilians from a fire over pursuing the fleeing villains, and he was one of the four Havoc members who got away in the final battle.

people.name: The Mosquito
people.bio: Henry Stroman always had a knack for science. He had a love for both Entomology and Engineering and it was something he always put his whole heart into. This alienated him from his classmates and, along with his small stature, caused him to be mercilessly bullied. Highly intelligent, Henry dreamed of ways to get back at a world he felt was against him. He designed a suit of armor based on an insect that fascinated him, the mosquito. Despite its small size, it can be a nuisance to things much larger than itself. Now Stroman works as an engineer and also as an element in the criminal underworld.
people.story: The Mosquito fought the Ultras at the Hillview Reservoir, trading blows with a steady stream of cringe-worthy jokes and puns. He escaped along with Blast Freeze and Blaze, and was one of the four Havoc members who got away in the final battle.

people.name: Blaze
people.bio: Jamaal grew up in New York City as a normal kid until his mutant abilities started to manifest as a teenager. Although he originally felt like he should use these new abilities to help people, he was ostracized because everyone he encountered was afraid of him. He became bitter and eventually befriended a fellow mutant named Blast Freeze, who was the first person he could relate to. Blast Freeze became his mentor and guided him into a life of crime.
people.story: Blaze started the fire in the office building near the Hillview Reservoir. The Ultras chose to save the civilians trapped inside rather than chase the fleeing villains, and Blaze escaped. He was one of the four Havoc members who got away in the final battle.

people.name: Kill Zone
people.bio: Kill Zone is an assassin for hire that operates world wide, renowned for his ability to kill super-powered heroes. Kill Zone was given his powers as a member of the German government "Chosen" program, an attempt to create super-powered heroes through a super serum, but lost his sanity during the process.
people.story: Kill Zone joined Shockwave in the attack on the UN General Assembly, where Steel Talon and Trauma Hawk fought them before Bones arrived to help save the Assembly members from falling debris. He was one of the four Havoc members who escaped in the final battle.

people.name: Lynx
people.bio: Sarah Hemphill was a typical teenager until her mutant abilities came to the forefront and changed her appearance. She developed the abilities of a Lynx, complete with claws and fangs. Her appearance caused her to be ridiculed and feared in everyday life. At first she tried to hide her appearance, but she eventually became angry at a world that didn't accept her. Sarah became the villain Lynx, and deciding to use her powers to take whatever she wants whenever she wants it.
people.story: Havoc was afraid that the lawyer Erwin Lancaster, who had recruited its members for Shockwave, could identify them to the police or the Ultras. Lynx murdered him to tie up that loose end. Bones discovered Lynx at the crime scene. Lynx was captured with Shockwave in the final battle beneath the city.

Blackwell co-led the Genesis Alliance, which received the stolen Infinity Codex from Copperhead's crew. The Ultras defeated him and Dr. Evelyn Stone at their Nevada desert base, but Dr. Psionic swooped in and took the Codex. After the Ultras defeated them, Blackwell and Stone cut a deal with ORACLE to stay out of prison and now work for the organization, running Genesis Technologies. In Havoc Unleashed they helped the Ultras trace the communication devices and explained the stolen gravity amplification devices.

Stone co-led the Genesis Alliance with Blackwell. The Ultras defeated them at their Nevada desert base, after which they cut a deal with ORACLE to stay out of prison and now work for the organization, running Genesis Technologies. In Havoc Unleashed they helped the Ultras trace the communication devices and explained the stolen gravity amplification devices.

Victor Cross, Director of ORACLE, brought the Ultras together to recover the stolen Infinity Codex, and later shared what he knew about Dr. Psionic (Arthur Cromwell). ORACLE has since become the team's source of intelligence and technology.
Frankie Vega pointed the Ultras to Copperhead's air strip, and again helped the team in their early investigation of Havoc.
